tok 1.0 "Becoming a parent"

pool org "Maternity leave support"
  lane parent "Parent"
    start begin "Leave planning needed"
    task select "Select a model"
    task collect "Collect relevant information"
    task decide "Decide about extension"
    xor extend "Extend the leave?"
    end done "Leave ended"
  lane system "Leave system"
    task fetch "Fetch information about potential models"
    and notify
    task nss "Notify Social Security"
    task nco "Notify Company"
    and notified
    task gather "Gather information from companies"
    task extendleave "Extend the leave"
    xor merge

flow begin -> fetch -> select -> collect -> notify
flow notify -> nss -> notified
flow notify -> nco -> notified
flow notified -> gather -> decide -> extend
flow extend -> extendleave "yes"
flow extend -> done "no"
flow extendleave -> done
